A '''power surge dampener''' was a weapon component. It was used in [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] such as the [[Defender sporting blaster pistol/Legends|Defender sporting blaster pistol]] to protect the weapon's delicate [[Actuating module/Legends|actuating module]]. The [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] was also equipped with a power surge dampener, which worked in conjunction with a [[Power Flow Regulator]].<ref name="EGWT" />
